method: We took portable ENERGY STAR dehumidifiers certified at 45 to 55 pints per day (the 50-pint class under the current DOE test) and compared the most efficient by IEF, with a 10% weight on capacity. The five-year electricity cost is shown for each (certified yearly energy use x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5). Every model tied with the last one on the selection criterion is listed, so the cut never picks among equals.
name: Best 50-pint dehumidifiers, ranked by certified efficiency
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100
